analysis.summary: Accent Microcell Ltd held its earnings conference call on May 16, 2026, to discuss financial and operational performance for the half year and fiscal year ended March 31, 2026. Management highlighted growth driven by premium products like MCC spheres and SMCC, increasing export share to roughly 63%, and achieving a total sales volume of 15,000 metric tons. The company addressed delays in starting Unit 3 Phase 1 due to abnormal monsoons and regulatory/environmental approvals, expecting commercial production around June 2026. Additionally, management discussed robust end-market demand with an order book of around 4,000 metric tons and detailed strategies for upcoming phases and wood pulp-based CMC and CCS production. Accent Microcell Ltd reported a 31.92% increase in revenue from operations to ₹34,903.28 lakhs for FY26 along with a PAT of ₹4,385.85 lakhs.
